2.5 h lectureEvery week · lecturer: Rivky Ollech, DevOps developer at Varonis (being acquired by Proofpoint)

Team rolesDevelopers and one responsible DevOps engineer per primary project

The primary project

Each team launches its primary project in DevOps Bootcamp week 3—ideally from the team's own idea, with one or two placeholder projects available. It must integrate external APIs. Over the two courses it is containerized, deployed, secured, and AI-enabled, and in FDE Practitioner it is delivered to a real client by a deadline. CI/CD and Kubernetes exercises run on a shared practice project.

Good to know
  • Cloud and AI services needed for practice are not included in tuition; estimated services and costs are shared in advance.
  • Career support and relevant opportunity connections are offered, but employment or placement is not guaranteed.
